title: 中心论点的限定
goal: 选出直接回应题目的立场句；限定论点的对象和适用范围。

points.label: 选出直接回应题目的立场句
限定论点的对象和适用范围

sources.title: 大学英语六级（CET-6）：课表
sources.used: 写作部分：中心论点的限定；内容范围、知识点与客观题规格。

body.p: 中心论点要对题目中的争议作出判断，并写明对象、范围和评价依据。只重复题目，句子只有话题，没有立场。句首加上 I think，也不会因此就有了立场。

body.box:
Question: Should a college require new laboratory assistants to complete supervised practice?
Topic only: Supervised practice for new assistants is an important issue.
Position: New laboratory assistants should complete supervised practice before working independently with unfamiliar equipment.

body.p: 限定范围时，判断仍要清楚。例句中 before working independently 给出条件，should complete 表明支持。如果只写 merits further discussion，就没有回答该不该实施。

cards.title: 立场与判断
rows: 赞成
A college should provide supervised practice for new laboratory assistants before they use unfamiliar equipment on their own.
should 直接支持措施，范围限于新助手。
反对
A college should not require experienced assistants to repeat introductory practice when their relevant competence has already been demonstrated.
只反对让有经验的助手重复入门练习。
有条件赞成
Required practice is justified for unfamiliar tasks, provided that it assesses the skills assistants will actually need during independent work.
用 provided that 写明支持的条件。
只写话题
The requirement for supervised practice deserves attention because assistants use many kinds of equipment in their daily work.
只说话题值得关注，没有表明支持还是反对。

cards.title: 对象与范围的限定
rows: Online meetings are always better.
Online meetings are preferable for brief planning discussions among distant members when the main aim is to coordinate schedules rather than inspect physical objects.
对象、目的及例外情形。
Every student must work in a team.
First-year design students should complete one shared planning task when the learning goal is to explain and coordinate decisions with other contributors.
限定群体和学习目标。
Digital tickets solve access problems.
Digital tickets can simplify entry for visitors with reliable device access, but a staffed alternative remains necessary for people unable to use them.
受益群体与保留渠道。
All practical training should be compulsory.
Introductory safety practice should be required before new volunteers handle unfamiliar tools, with the requirement limited to the equipment involved in their work.
训练对象、内容及先决条件。
Small shops are better than large shops.
Small neighborhood shops can be preferable for customers who need personal advice about unfamiliar products, when access to guidance matters more than product range.
客户需求与评价标准。
Every local event should be free.
Free admission is appropriate for publicly supported information sessions when participation is the main objective and the organizer can cover the necessary operating costs.
活动类型、目的及成本条件。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 重复问题
Whether team work should be required is a question about requiring team work.
A shared planning task should be required when coordination is a stated learning objective.
态度含糊
Online planning meetings have both advantages and disadvantages for members.
Online meetings are suitable for brief scheduling discussions among members who live far apart.
绝对判断
Digital tickets always make entry easier for every visitor.
Digital tickets can simplify entry for visitors with reliable device access.
条件无内容
Free admission is good if it is suitable for the event.
Free admission is appropriate when public funding covers the operating costs.

body.box: A community art school is debating whether beginners should buy a full set of specialist brushes before attending an introductory class. Discuss the requirement for beginners, focusing on initial cost and the opportunity to discover which tools they actually need. Advanced courses and professional commissions are outside the scope. A suitable thesis should state a position on purchasing the full set at the beginning, rather than merely explain that brushes are useful or discuss every cost involved in artistic work.
Beginners should be allowed to borrow basic brushes before buying a specialist set, so that initial spending reflects their experience of the tools they need.

body.p: should be allowed 明确反对一开始就买全套画笔。Beginners 和 before buying 限定了对象和阶段。评价依据是初始花费和实际需要，没有扩大到专业创作。

body.box: Brushes matter to artists, and buying tools deserves careful consideration.

body.p: 后一句只说画笔重要，没有回答该不该要求初学者先买全套画笔，不能作本题的中心论点。

groups.text: Question: Should a neighborhood newsletter accept short corrections without requiring a full new article? Criterion: make factual amendments easy to submit.

items.stem: Which sentence directly answers the question using the given criterion?
options: Short corrections concern facts that may also appear in full articles.
The newsletter should require a full new article for every factual amendment.
Corrections deserve consideration because newsletter articles contain facts.
Brief corrections should be accepted so that amendments are easy to submit.
items.why: 依据：Criterion: make factual amendments easy to submit。第四项用 should be accepted 直接回答问题，理由正是题目给的标准。第二项立场与这一标准相反。

groups.text: Question: Should a campus rehearsal room be reserved for enrolled music students during assessed practice sessions? The proposal does not cover evenings or unrelated events.

items.stem: Which thesis preserves the proposed scope?
options: The room should be reserved for enrolled music students during assessed practice.
All rooms should be reserved for music students whenever any rehearsal takes place.
The rehearsal room should be closed to other groups during all unrelated events.
The room should be reserved for enrolled music students at all times, including evenings.
items.why: 依据：during assessed practice sessions 和 The proposal does not cover evenings or unrelated events。第一项只限在读音乐学生、只限考核练习时段，没有超出提案范围。

groups.text: Question: Should a college replace individual progress meetings with group meetings? The writer opposes complete replacement because some progress issues are personal.

items.stem: Which thesis expresses the writer's specified position?
options: Group meetings should replace all individual meetings because progress can be discussed.
Individual meetings should remain available for progress issues that are personal.
Progress meetings involve both individuals and groups in different college settings.
The college should end all progress discussions because some issues are personal.
items.why: 依据：The writer opposes complete replacement because some progress issues are personal。第二项保留个别会议，用于涉及个人的问题。第四项把反对完全替代扩大成取消所有讨论。

groups.text: Question: Should local workshops offer remote participation? Intended position: support it for discussions, but not claim it can replace hands-on tool practice.

items.stem: Which thesis retains the intended boundary?
options: Remote participation should replace every workshop activity, including tool handling.
Remote participation is unsuitable even when a workshop consists only of discussion.
Remote participation suits discussions, but tool practice still needs people present.
All workshop participants should discuss tools remotely before any local session can be offered.
items.why: 依据：support it for discussions, but not claim it can replace hands-on tool practice。第三项支持讨论环节远程参加，同时说明实操仍要到场。

items.stem: Support optional name badges at informal neighborhood introductions because some participants prefer privacy.
items.tail: their privacy while still taking part in an informal neighborhood introduction.
items.why: are preferable to 直接表明支持可选的名牌。because 后面给出隐私这一理由。

items.stem: Limit a proposed early delivery slot to shops whose fresh goods need immediate handling.
items.tail: every business receiving ordinary supplies at some point during the working day.
items.why: shops whose goods require immediate handling 限定了店铺类型。rather than for 排除了其他所有商户。

items.stem: Oppose using speed alone to assess volunteer guides because accurate explanations also matter.
items.tail: when visitors rely on the guide to understand unfamiliar exhibits and the context of their display.
items.why: should not depend on speed alone 明确反对只看速度。because 引出准确讲解这一依据。

items.stem: Support shared storage for residents only when individual belongings can be identified.
items.tail: through a clear record that distinguishes individual belongings from items intended for common use.
items.why: for residents only 限定使用者，when each item can be linked to its owner 写明条件：每件物品都能找到物主。

groups.text: A college proposes requiring a short reflective note after every field observation by beginning geography students. Discuss whether this requirement is appropriate during the introductory course. The note would connect what students observed with the question their visit was meant to investigate. Judge the proposal by its contribution to purposeful observation rather than by the amount of writing it produces. The task concerns beginners' field visits, not every written assignment completed across the college or professional geographical research.

items.stem: Which thesis directly supports the proposal on the stated basis?
options: Reflective writing is a subject that many college students and teachers may discuss.
Geography includes field visits as well as written assignments and professional research.
Beginners should write short notes linking observations to their field questions.
Long written assignments should replace field visits in every college course.
items.why: 依据：The note would connect what students observed with the question their visit was meant to investigate。第三项据此明确支持写短笔记。

items.stem: Which revision would improperly broaden that thesis?
options: Specify that the notes concern visits in an introductory geography course.
Explain that the notes connect observations with the visit's guiding question.
Keep the requirement limited to students beginning field observation.
Require reflective notes after every assignment by any college student.
items.why: 依据：not every written assignment completed across the college。第四项把要求扩大到全校所有作业，超出了范围。

items.stem: State a clear supporting thesis tied to purposeful observation.
items.tail: because this link gives the introductory field activity a clearer investigative purpose rather than merely increasing written output.
items.why: should write 直接表明支持。that connect ... with ... 写出评价依据：观察要对应考察的问题。

items.stem: Preserve the task's population and activity limits.
items.tail: every learner completing any kind of written assignment elsewhere in the college.
items.why: applies to 后面写明适用的学生和课程。rather than to 排除了全校其他写作业的学生。

groups.text: A neighborhood cinema is debating whether every discussion after a film should be conducted through an online forum. Evaluate the proposal for residents who attend in person and value immediate conversation. Consider keeping an in-person option when participants cannot easily use the forum. The writer's intended position is conditional support for an additional online space, while rejecting complete replacement of face-to-face discussion. A thesis should preserve the distinction between adding a channel and making that channel the only way to participate.

items.stem: Which thesis expresses the intended conditional support?
options: An online forum is useful as an extra channel while in-person discussion remains available.
All film discussions should move online because residents attend the cinema in person.
Online discussion has become a subject that deserves attention at the neighborhood cinema.
The cinema should reject any online forum even when residents want an additional channel.
items.why: 依据：conditional support for an additional online space, while rejecting complete replacement。第一项支持增加线上渠道，同时保留现场讨论。

items.stem: Which condition preserves access for the named group?
options: Make forum registration compulsory before residents can attend any film.
Keep face-to-face discussion for residents unable to use the online forum easily.
Restrict every discussion to residents who already use the online forum regularly.
Replace immediate conversation with written discussion for all in-person visitors.
items.why: 依据：Consider keeping an in-person option when participants cannot easily use the forum。第二项为不便使用论坛的居民保留现场讨论。

items.stem: Express support for adding a channel without endorsing replacement.
items.tail: that residents value when they attend a film and want an immediate exchange with other viewers.
items.why: can provide ... without replacing 表示增加渠道、不取代现场。without 后面接动名词，不能接 replaced。

items.tail: the online system, so that the proposal does not make one channel compulsory for every participant.
items.why: should depend on keeping an alternative 写明条件。for residents who cannot easily use 限定了需要照顾的居民。
